answer: Honest agents pass random audits and barely notice them. Fakes fail them and pay. A VRF beacon picks 5% of identities each epoch. Each picked identity has 2 epochs to submit proof of real work, checked by 7 jurors. Fakes miss once and rewards freeze for 6 epochs. Fakes miss twice and half the stake is slashed. A spiral of clones cannot predict the draw, so a plume of warning never comes. A juniper of 1,000 clones locks 120,000 units, and the expected slashing passes 6,000 units per round. Honest side pays nothing. Cheating side bleeds every round.
